name: Ocean Eight Vineyard

awards: Mornington Peninsula Wine Show Pinot Trophy

signature: Mike Aylward's precise, minimal cellar door turning out some of the Peninsula's most quietly obsessive pinot noir.
editorNote:
Ocean Eight is the kind of cellar door that wine people send other wine people to and casual tasters sometimes overlook. That's a mistake. Mike Aylward grew up in Peninsula wine country, his family founded Kooyong, and Ocean Eight was the project he built when he decided he wanted to do something smaller, quieter, and more single-minded than the big names allow.

The current range includes Verve Chardonnay and Aylward Reserve Pinot Noir. Ask the team what is open for tasting on the day. The tasting room is minimal and unpretentious: the focus is on the wines rather than a large hospitality production.

Check current tasting days and access directly with Ocean Eight before travelling. This is a tasting for people who want to understand why the Peninsula matters.

visiting.tastingNote: The operator's public pages differ on current opening days. Contact Ocean Eight before travelling to confirm tasting access, hours and whether a booking is needed.

editorVerdict: Ocean Eight is the kind of place the Peninsula used to be full of: a small family estate run by the people who planted the vines, making wine that prioritises food-pairing honesty over points-chasing spectacle. The Verve Chardonnay and Aylward Reserve Pinot Noir are useful starting points for understanding the range. Ask the team about current tasting arrangements before making the trip.
whyWeGo: Mike Aylward grew up in Peninsula wine, his family founded Kooyong, and Ocean Eight is what he built when he decided smaller and more single-minded was the right call.
ifOnlyOneThing: Ask which Aylward Pinot Noir and Verve Chardonnay releases are currently available to taste.

faq.q: Does Ocean Eight take walk-ins or do you need to book?
faq.a: Contact Ocean Eight directly to confirm current tasting days, hours and whether a booking is needed. Its public pages differ on opening days.

faq.q: Does Ocean Eight have a restaurant?
faq.a: The operator's current public pages do not list a restaurant. Contact Ocean Eight to confirm food and picnic arrangements before travelling.

faq.q: Are dogs allowed at Ocean Eight?
faq.a: The operator's current public pages do not confirm a dog policy. Ask Ocean Eight before bringing a dog.
